methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The EEM framework is a managerial tool that assesses the maturity of an energy-intensive SME

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Maturity assessment framework (EEM) for energy-intensive SMEs: proposes a qualitative organizational maturity model (7 EE dimensions, 5 maturity levels, 19-item survey scored by weighted average), not an EnPI/EnB measurement model. Specific energy consumption values (0.045 toe/t; furnace 1.76 GJ/t) are reported only incidentally as case-company characteristics and are never proposed, constructed, normalised, or evaluated as a model. Falls under the v2.3 carve-out for maturity assessments without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This study attempts to plug these gaps by proposing an energy efficiency maturity (EEM)

stage1.notes: EEM maturity framework (proposal + steel re-rolling mill case study, India). SEC reported incidentally (mill 0.045 toe/t; furnace 1.76 GJ/t, 25% efficiency); no EnPI/EnB model constructed or evaluated. Ineligible per maturity-assessment carve-out; not a review/synthesis, so borderline flag not set.
